mechanism: Split one original sentence into ordered semantic phrases. Give each phrase one legible typographic state and one physical operation that expresses its meaning, while preserving a visible carrier from the previous phase. Increase contrast, spatial scale and motion energy in controlled steps, then reverse the priority at the end: stop all movement, restore the full sentence and hold it long enough to read. The reusable mechanism is semantic phrase-to-physics escalation followed by complete-language lockup, not the source quotation, fonts, palette or exact effects.

invariants.rule: Begin with one original sentence divided into a fixed semantic order; reveal the first phrase from a minimal baseline.
invariants.ablation_failure: A decorative opening without ordered text gives later effects nothing to develop.

invariants.rule: Give every new phrase one readable typographic state and one physical behavior tied to its semantic role.
invariants.purpose: Makes meaning drive motion instead of decorating it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Generic transitions or illegible words sever the phrase-to-effect relationship.

invariants.rule: Carry one visible element, material or motion consequence from each phase into the next.
invariants.purpose: Maintains one continuous argument across changing designs.
invariants.ablation_failure: Independent title cards become an unrelated typography reel.

invariants.rule: Escalate at least two of scale, contrast, spatial depth or motion energy in a controlled sequence.
invariants.purpose: Builds retention and makes the terminal maximum earned.
invariants.ablation_failure: Equal-intensity phases flatten the arc; simultaneous excess becomes chaotic.

invariants.rule: Stop the escalation and reassemble the complete sentence in a stable readable final hold.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on fragments or one giant word leaves the language unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source quote Every great change begins quietly, grows through courage, and becomes impossible to ignore
the source MiniMax and Hailuo marks
the source black-orange-white palette, serif-script-condensed font pairing and exact word layout
the source spark, comma ripple, orange sunrise, glass fracture, editorial grid and white-block sequence
the source exact timing, camera pass-through and three red emphasized words in the final card

instantiations.concept: An original civic-navigation film uses the sentence 'Small signals become shared direction.' A pin-light draws SMALL SIGNALS, its pulse becomes connected route lines, SHARED expands into a layered transit map and the full sentence settles over a quiet pale station plan.
